  {"step": 1, "file": "lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "fuzz_parse_http_request", "line": 1624, "var": "data_copy", "code": "memcpy(data_copy, data, length);", "note": "Attacker-controlled raw input (24 bytes) is copied into the 32767-byte data_copy buffer. The input starts with the PROXY v2 signature 0x0d0a0d0a."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "read_request_finalizer", "line": 905, "var": "helper->buffer->len", "code": "memmem(helper->buffer->value, helper->buffer->len, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4)", "note": "The finalizer finds \\r\\n\\r\\n at offset 0 (the PROXY v2 signature prefix) and returns FINALIZER_DONE, so parsing proceeds with buffer->len = 24."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol", "line": 1153, "var": "buffer", "code": "case MULTICHAR_CONSTANT('\\x0D','\\x0A','\\x0D','\\x0A'): return parse_proxy_protocol_v2(request, buffer);", "note": "The first 4 bytes match the PROXY v2 signature, so parse_proxy_protocol_v2 is invoked on the 24-byte buffer."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol_v2", "line": 232, "var": "hdr->len", "code": "size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len);", "note": "hdr->len is read from bytes 14-15 of the input (0x0024 = 36). size = 16 + 36 = 52."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol_v2", "line": 233, "var": "size", "code": "if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL;", "note": "sizeof(*hdr) is 52 (12 sig + 1 cmd_ver + 1 fam + 2 len + 36-byte union). The check 52 > 52 is false, so the size check passes even though the actual input is only 24 bytes."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol_v2", "line": 236, "var": "hdr->cmd_ver", "code": "if (LIKELY(hdr->cmd_ver == PROXY))", "note": "cmd_ver byte (offset 12) is 0x21 (PROXY) and fam (offset 13) is 0x11 (TCP4), so the address fields are read from the union."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol_v2", "line": 278, "var": "buffer", "code": "buffer += size;", "note": "buffer is advanced by size=52 bytes, moving past the end of the 24 bytes of actual input data."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol_v2", "line": 281, "var": "adjusted_size", "code": "const size_t adjusted_size = (size_t)(helper->buffer->value + helper->buffer->len - buffer);", "note": "adjusted_size = 24 - 52 = -28, which underflows to a huge size_t value because buffer now points 52 bytes past the start while only 24 bytes were read."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol_v2", "line": 282, "var": "helper->crlfcrlf", "code": "helper->crlfcrlf = memmem(buffer, adjusted_size, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);", "note": "memmem is called with the underflowed huge adjusted_size, causing an out-of-bounds read beyond the 32767-byte data_copy buffer, triggering the buffer overflow / crash."}
]
EOF
echo "trace written"; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('valid json, steps:', len(d))"

1. Input file read into `data_copy[32767]` in `fuzz_parse_http_request`
2. `read_request_finalizer` finds `\r\n\r\n` at offset 0, returns DONE
3. `parse_http_request` → `parse_proxy_protocol` dispatches on `\x0D\x0A\x0D\x0A` → `parse_proxy_protocol_v2`
4. `hdr->len` = 36 (offset 14-15), `size = 16 + 36 = 52`
5. Check `52 > 52`? No, passes
6. `hdr->cmd_ver` = 0x21 (PROXY), `hdr->fam` = 0x11 (TCP4)
7. Reads address data
8. `buffer += 52`
9. `adjusted_size = 24 - 52 = -28` → underflows to huge size_t
10. `memmem(buffer, huge, "\r\n\r\n", 4)` → out-of-bounds read → crash

Let me write the trace JSON.
